meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘:安装 npm 包、复制 pusher 模块并接入启动流程,每 60 秒推送一次数据快照,浏览器可看各页面与实时日志。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘,或使用 /add-dashboard 命令时触发;它只改动 src/index.ts 一处。

say.text: 帮我的 NanoClaw 装上监控仪表盘
say.note: 安装 npm 包并接入 index.ts 启动流程
改 .env 里的 DASHBOARD_PORT 后重启服务

say.text: 确认下仪表盘跑起来了没有
say.note: 用 curl 查 /api/status 等接口

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: it installs the npm package, copies the pusher module, wires it into src/index.ts, and pushes a JSON snapshot every 60 seconds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or run /add-dashboard; the skill makes a single edit in src/index.ts.

say_en.text: Add the monitoring dashboard to my NanoClaw
say_en.note: installs the npm package and edits index.ts

say_en.text: Check whether the dashboard is up
